Account Buffer Guide
The buffer is the required profit that protects the firm before you can make withdrawals. How and where you build it depends on your account type.
🏛	
OG Accounts
Standard OG & Express OG: Same Buffer Rules
How it works: You build your buffer profit in the Exhibition account. Once the buffer is reached, that exact amount rolls over into your Sim-Funded account as a static starting profit, even if you exceeded the consistency rule during exhibition. Your funded account opens at Account Size + Buffer.

MAX Accounts
Standard MAX & Express MAX: Same Buffer Rules
How it works: There is no Exhibition stage. Your funded account opens at the full Account Size. The drawdown starts immediately at Account Size − Buffer. You build the buffer inside the funded account before you can make any withdrawals.

Key Differences at a Glance
 
OG Accounts
Standard OG & Express OG
▸Buffer is built in the Exhibition account
▸Exhibition profit target = buffer amount
▸Buffer rolls over as a static dollar amount into funded
▸Funded account opens ABOVE account size
▸50K example: Opens at $52,000 (50K + $2,000 buffer)
▸Drawdown floor is fixed at the account size (e.g. $50,000)
	
MAX Accounts
Standard MAX & Express MAX
▸No Exhibition stage: goes straight to funded
▸Buffer is built inside the funded account
▸Funded account opens AT account size
▸Drawdown starts BELOW account size immediately
▸50K example: Opens at $50,000, drawdown at $48,000
▸Cannot withdraw until buffer is fully built
 
Important: On all funded accounts, you can only withdraw profits that are $500 or more above your buffer. You can never withdraw into your buffer. For Express MAX funded accounts, you must also have 5 winning days before each payout.
